transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Thank you so much for seeing me, it's really nice to meet you too. Um... I hope I explain this okay, I'm not always the best with words. 

But, well... I came in because my family and friends are a little upset with me, and I really want to do the right thing to fix it. We've just been having this disagreement. They keep saying these bank papers prove that nothing was taken from me. But... well, I don't want to sound mean or anything, but for over a year now, I’ve just known that they’re hiding my money. They use things like bills, or saying they gave it to fundraisers, or making up trip plans just to cover it up. 

I really don't like arguing with them, I hate it actually, but I just have to keep confronting them about it until they tell the truth. I'm just trying to get it sorted out so we can be okay again... does that make sense? I hope it's okay that I'm telling you all this, I just want to make sure I'm answering your question right.
Aside from your concerns about the money, have you been experiencing any unusual sensations, like hearing voices or seeing things that other people don't seem to notice?

Oh, no, no, nothing like that. I promise, I don't hear voices or see things or anything strange like that. I know how that might sound, and I really don't want you to think I'm... well, you know, crazy or anything. I'm just a normal person, really. I just... I just know what's happening with my money, that's all. Is it okay that I said no to that? I hope I'm giving you the right answers, I just want to be helpful.
Have you ever had any head injuries, seizures, or been diagnosed with any significant medical conditions that affect your brain or body?

Oh, no, sir. I've always been real healthy, thank goodness. I never had any seizures or... or hit my head bad or anything like that. I try really hard to take good care of myself, you know, so I don't cause any trouble or be a burden to anybody. 

I don't have any big sicknesses or anything wrong with my body or my brain, I promise. I hope that's a good thing? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information... did I answer that part okay for you?
Have you been feeling unusually low in energy or depressed, or conversely, have you felt unusually energetic, talkative, or like you didn't need much sleep lately?

Oh, no, I haven't felt depressed or anything like that. I try really hard to stay positive, you know? I don't want to bring anyone down. And I sleep just fine, I think... just a normal amount, I'm not staying up all night or feeling like I have too much energy. I just go about my day like anyone else would. 

I really try to keep a good attitude, even with... well, with the money thing going on. I just want everything to be peaceful. Is that what you were asking? I hope I'm making sense, I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
Do you feel that there are any other situations in your life where people are acting in ways that don't make sense to you, or that there are other hidden agendas going on around you?

Oh, um... no. No, sir. Everybody else is... well, they're just normal, I guess. I don't think anybody else is doing anything secret or... or hiding things from me. It's really just that one thing, with my money. 

I try real hard to get along with everybody, you know? I don't want you to think I'm the kind of person who goes around looking for trouble or... or thinking bad things about people all the time. I really try to be good to everyone so they'll be good to me. So, no, nothing else like that going on. 

Is that... does that make sense? I hope I'm answering that the way you need me to. I just want to be a good patient for you.
When your family shows you the bank papers that contradict your belief, what is your explanation for why those documents appear to show that your money is still there?

Well, um... I know they show me those papers. And I really don't want to call my family liars, I promise I don't. I hate arguing with them, it makes me feel just awful. But... well, for over a year now, I just... I know they're hiding it. 

They keep saying the bank papers prove nothing was taken, but... I think they just make it look that way. Like, they use regular things—like paying bills, or those fundraisers, or planning trips and stuff—just to move things around and cover it up. I try not to be a bother, I really do, but I have to keep confronting them about it, just until they finally tell me the truth. I just want the truth so we can be a happy family again and stop fighting. 

I know it probably sounds mean that I keep bringing it up to them... I hope you don't think I'm a bad person for doing that? I don't want to cause trouble, I just have to know. Did I explain that okay for you?

When you think about these bank papers and how the money is being moved, do you believe that people outside of your family—such as bank employees or other individuals—are also involved in hiding the truth from you?

Oh, um... no. No, I don't think anyone at the bank is doing anything wrong. I don't want to get anyone in trouble, especially not people just doing their jobs, you know? 

It's just... it's just my family. I don't think there's any big plot with the bank tellers or anything like that. I really try not to think badly of people I don't even know. I just... I just think my family is doing it on their own. 

I hope that's the right answer? I don't want to sound like I'm accusing the whole world of things, I promise I'm not like that. I just... I just want my family to be honest with me. Does that make sense?

Aside from the situation with your money, have you ever felt that you have special abilities, a unique connection to someone famous, or that you are meant for a very important purpose that others don't seem to recognize?

Oh, my goodness, no. No, nothing like that. I'm just... I'm just a regular person, you know? I don't have any special powers or... or know anybody famous. I'm not important like that at all. 

I just try to live a quiet life and be good to people. I wouldn't ever go around making up stories about being special or better than anyone else. I promise I don't think like that. I just want everything to be peaceful and normal. 

I hope you believe me? I really don't want you to think I'm... well, crazy, or making things up. I'm just answering exactly what you asked. Did I do okay with that one?
Are there any other beliefs or concerns you have about your life that your family or friends have told you are not true, besides the situation with your money?

Oh, um... no. No, nothing else. Just the money thing. I really try not to be a difficult person, you know? I don't want to cause any other problems or have any other disagreements with anyone. 

I just... I just want to get along with my family. I don't have any other worries like that, I promise. I try to be very easygoing about everything else in my life. I don't want you or them to think I'm just looking for things to complain about, because I'm really not. 

Is that what you were asking? I hope I'm being helpful. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
